Asia/Singapore is UTC+8 (standard). US/Mountain is UTC-7.  
Target time = 17:00 + (-7 - 8) = 17:00 - 15 hours.  
17:00 - 15 = 02:00 on the same calendar day (since subtraction doesn’t cross midnight backward in 24-hour wrap? Actually 17 - 15 = 2, no wrap).  
Date remains April 20, 1567.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1567-04-20 02:00
